metadata.description: Practices distilled from building a local-first Expo/React Native iOS app: native build and simulator workflow, WatermelonDB safety, and verification discipline.

plugins.name: expo-ios-native
plugins.description: Expo/React Native iOS native workflow: when a prebuild is mandatory, Debug vs Release device builds, proving a native module actually linked, driving the simulator headlessly, and reading an on-device SQLite database without losing the WAL.

plugins.name: watermelondb-safety
plugins.description: WatermelonDB schema migrations that do not silently wipe the user's database, plus the test idioms its fire-and-forget write queue and decorator models require.

plugins.name: verification-discipline
plugins.description: Stop shipping confident, unverified claims: execute assertions instead of asserting them, write fixtures that can actually discriminate the condition they name, run mutants that really applied, and use structural criteria where no test can reach.
